Multistart protocol and the two per-branch records quoted here

Run settings: OMP/MKL/OpenBLAS/NumExpr/VecLib thread variables set to 8; MKL_CBWR=COMPATIBLE; JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu; jax_enable_x64=True. The BLAS/LAPACK build version was not written to the archived record and is marked unrecorded.

notes: The target is declared as a stationary point, not a minimum; the archived t106 record does not contain a curvature spectrum for N2/cc-pVDZ CAS(2,2).
The third stationary point reported by t106 has no per-branch record. The inventory is therefore incomplete and the certificate carries that as a residual risk.
The canonical interval is an exact gauge transform of the two-electron singlet reconstructed from the measured natural occupations. It is not a new electronic-structure calculation.
The CAS(2,2) active space has no degenerate partner pair. The N2/6-31G CAS(4,4) degeneracy in related_measurements is out of scope for this target.
